messages.author: ishita.kaur.100472@cindervalefinecheese.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new Canada Chapter space for ICF members. We can use this thread for regional updates and coordinating our upcoming spring tastings in Ontario and Quebec.

messages.author: emily.ackerley.102103@loamfieldcheeseschool.example
messages.text: Thanks for setting this up, Akira. The Saint-Hyacinthe crew is finishing up the schedule for our regional milk quality workshop next month.

messages.author: salome.faucher.100400@ottermerecheesemaking.example
messages.text: The fall syllabus is nearly set. We have about twenty students registered for the introductory affinage modules starting in October.

messages.author: lakshmi.agarwal.101124@quillpost.example
messages.text: Given the current health restrictions, all upcoming in-person tastings are postponed until further notice. ICF staff are putting together guidance on virtual meetings.

messages.author: emily.ives.101790@bluebarn.example
messages.text: We have transitioned our spring curriculum entirely online. Attendance for the remote technical sessions has been surprisingly steady across all provinces.

messages.author: salome.faucher.100400@ottermerecheesemaking.example
messages.text: Planning for the virtual symposium is underway. We need a few more volunteers to help moderate the breakout sessions on cheese microbiology.

messages.author: lakshmi.agarwal.101124@quillpost.example
messages.text: I can help with moderation on the afternoon panels if we are still short on people. Let me know the final timing.

messages.author: ishita.kaur.100472@cindervalefinecheese.example
messages.text: It is great to see the annual conference returning to an in-person format this year. Competition entries from our chapter are higher than ever.

messages.author: emily.ackerley.102103@loamfieldcheeseschool.example
messages.text: Our facility capacity is completely stretched right now with the surge in local demand. Everyone is working overtime to keep up with orders.

messages.author: salome.faucher.100400@ottermerecheesemaking.example
messages.text: We are locking in venue contracts for the autumn workshop series. We opted for a slightly larger space in Guelph to accommodate the waiting list.

messages.author: ishita.kaur.100472@cindervalefinecheese.example
messages.text: Happy New Year to the chapter. Sponsorship holds for our regional events look stable for the upcoming year despite general staffing pressures.

messages.author: emily.ives.101790@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Production numbers remain high across most vats, though finding experienced vat hands is still proving difficult in our region.

messages.author: ishita.kaur.100472@cindervalefinecheese.example
messages.text: With ongoing cost inflation, please remember that ICF offers hardship dues relief for members needing temporary assistance with their renewals.

messages.author: emily.ackerley.102103@loamfieldcheeseschool.example
messages.text: We are organizing a support circle for small creameries navigating succession planning and recent operational changes.

messages.author: ishita.kaur.100472@cindervalefinecheese.example
messages.text: Input costs have finally begun to ease across the supply chain, which is a welcome relief for spring make schedules.

messages.author: emily.ackerley.102103@loamfieldcheeseschool.example
messages.text: The focus for our next chapter meeting will be raw-milk aging rule updates and new traceability standards.

messages.author: salome.faucher.100400@ottermerecheesemaking.example
messages.text: I am putting together a summary document on the traceability guidelines for anyone who cannot make the live session next week.

messages.author: lakshmi.agarwal.101124@quillpost.example
messages.text: Thank you, Salome. Let us wrap up the autumn meeting registrations by Friday so we can finalize the catering numbers with the venue.
